N1.name: Skills and their levels
N1.sees: The engine drafts each skill as what a child can do, with {levels}. A person reads and approves it once, on [Skills to approve](/guide/skills-to-approve).

N2.name: The question bank
N2.sees: The engine makes every question from its level's rule and works out its answer. Any member of staff can reword or remove one in the [Question bank](/guide/question-bank).

N3.name: Old papers read in
N3.sees: Papers children sat before the printed codes were read in, so every child started with answers. There is no page of its own.

N4.name: Say what was taught
N4.sees: You say what the class was taught. The engine proposes which skills that covered, and you confirm. See [What needs doing](/guide/what-needs-doing#taught).

N5.name: Each child's next paper
N5.sees: The engine proposes each child's next paper from their answers. You see every question first and may change it. See [Assessments](/guide/assessments#make).

N6.name: Worksheets and packs
N6.sees: Every question sits on a numbered worksheet with a printed code. The pack prints in handout order, with spare copies.

N7.name: The educator approves the pack
N7.sees: You look over the pack and approve it before it prints. See [Papers to approve](/guide/papers-to-approve#approve).

N8.name: Papers come back
N8.sees: You upload the scans or photos. The engine lines each page up with the page it was printed from. See [Upload papers](/guide/upload-papers#upload).

N9.name: Read, check and learn
N9.sees: The engine reads each answer and marks it by the answer key. What it is not sure of goes to you on [Check answers](/guide/check-answers#check).

N10.name: Each child's skills worked out
N10.sees: A signed off answer counts for every skill it used, and each child's skills are worked out again. See [Class results](/guide/class-results#a-child).

N11.name: Home assessment
N11.sees: A home assessment for each child, aimed at what they got wrong. You approve it on the child's page. See [Make a home assessment](/guide/class-results#home-assessment).

N12.name: Reports and planning
N12.sees: Parent reports written from the child's answers, approved by a person before a parent reads them. See [Parent reports](/guide/parent-reports).
